name: liqsteward
description: Manager-controlled operations and execution assurance for onchain vaults

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @liqsteward/api" "npm run dev -w @liqsteward/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @liqsteward/core && npm run build -w @liqsteward/api && npm run build -w @liqsteward/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @liqsteward/core && npm run build -w @liqsteward/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @liqsteward/core && npm run test -w @liqsteward/api
